Job Description
A quantitative investment firm is seeking a  Machine Learning Research Engineer  to join a highly technical team focused on applying advanced machine learning techniques to complex, real-world problems. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys combining mathematical rigor with hands-on engineering and wants to see research evolve into practical, impactful solutions. 
The team values curiosity, experimentation, and thoughtful decision-making. Rather than forcing problems into a single framework, you'll evaluate multiple approaches, select the most appropriate methodology, and build well-structured solutions that deliver measurable results. You'll have the opportunity to work on challenging machine learning initiatives while contributing to an evolving data and research platform.
Required Skills & Experience    Strong background in mathematics, statistics, optimization, or a related quantitative discipline  Experience applying machine learning techniques to solve complex business or research problems  Proficiency with Python and modern machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, XGBoost, or similar technologies  Experience designing, testing, and implementing machine learning models  Ability to build and maintain organized, scalable research codebases  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills  Experience evaluating multiple modeling approaches and selecting the best fit for a given problem  Ability to take projects from research and experimentation through production-ready implementation
  Desired Skills & Experience    Experience with reinforcement learning, neural networks, ensemble methods, gradient boosting, random forests, or genetic algorithms  GPU optimization and performance tuning experience  Familiarity with Spark and/or Databricks  Experience working within AWS or distributed computing environments  Exposure to large-scale data pipelines and machine learning infrastructure  Interest in quantitative finance, investing, or financial markets
  What You Will Be Doing
Daily Responsibilities    Research and evaluate machine learning techniques to solve challenging quantitative problems  Apply advanced mathematical concepts to feature engineering, model development, and optimization efforts  Explore new research papers and emerging technologies, translating ideas into practical experiments  Develop and maintain scalable machine learning systems and research tooling  Build clean, organized, and maintainable code that supports ongoing research efforts  Collaborate with engineers and researchers to improve data pipelines and platform capabilities  Utilize AI-assisted development tools responsibly while maintaining high standards for code quality and validation  Continuously experiment, iterate, and improve model performance based on quantitative results
  The Offer    Competitive base salary  Performance-based bonus opportunity  Exposure to cutting-edge machine learning research and engineering challenges  Collaborative and highly technical environment  Direct impact on research initiatives and technology strategy  Opportunity to work with modern cloud, distributed computing, and GPU-based technologies
